response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior full-stack/systems engineer with deep experience in web, embedded (some C/C++, DLang), and infrastructure work, but he lacks the core requirements for this role: no evidence of native Japanese proficiency, no Linux kernel investigation/modification experience, no LAN-switch or embedded networking security background (MACsec, 802.1X, NETCONF/SNMP), and his current C/UNIX experience is limited to a brief 2014-2015 stint. The mismatch on the mandatory Japanese language requirement alone makes him unsuitable for this position.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, high-quality software engineering experience across many stacks
Demonstrated systems-level programming ability (C/C++, DLang, low-latency async I/O)
Strong track record of technical leadership, mentoring, and open-source contribution
concerns: No indication of native or working Japanese proficiency, which is a hard requirement
No demonstrated Linux kernel investigation or source modification experience
No background in embedded networking/security domains (MACsec, 802.1X, switch chips, NETCONF/SNMP)

key_factors.factor: No Linux kernel or embedded networking security experience
Strong general C/systems programming and engineering seniority
